title: SMLT-MUGC: SMALL, MEDIUM, AND LARGE TEXTS - MACHINE VERSUS USER GENERATED CONTENT DETECTION AND COMPARISON

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating general bias and subjectivity in texts by calculating the frequency of specific linguistic indicators, such as hedges, factives, assertives, implicatives, and opinion words, alongside counting biased words using a predefined lexicon of biased terms.
